summary.en: A large multimodal model released with expanded capability and safety evaluation
summary.zh: 具备扩展能力与安全评测的大型多模态模型

description.en:
GPT-4 was introduced as a large multimodal model that accepts image and text inputs and produces text outputs. OpenAI reported broad improvements over GPT-3.5 on professional and academic benchmarks while emphasizing that the model still hallucinates, has a limited context window and can make reasoning errors.

The release paired capability evaluation with a technical report and system card describing adversarial testing, expert feedback and post-training safety work. This combined treatment of capability and risk made the GPT-4 release an important reference point for later frontier-model evaluations.
description.zh:
GPT-4 被介绍为能够接收图像与文本输入、生成文本输出的大型多模态模型。OpenAI 报告它在专业与学术基准上普遍超过 GPT-3.5，同时强调模型仍会产生幻觉、上下文窗口有限，并可能出现推理错误。

这次发布同时提供技术报告与系统卡，说明对抗测试、专家反馈和后训练安全工作。这种同时呈现能力与风险的发布方式，使 GPT-4 成为后来前沿模型评测的重要参照点。

text.en: GPT-4 accepts text and image inputs and produces text outputs.
text.zh: GPT-4 接收文本与图像输入，并生成文本输出。

text.en: OpenAI explicitly reported that GPT-4 can hallucinate, make reasoning errors and retain other reliability limitations.
text.zh: OpenAI 明确说明 GPT-4 仍会产生幻觉、出现推理错误并存在其他可靠性局限。

html.en: Large language models had already shown strong few-shot and instruction-following behavior, but leading systems were still mostly presented as text-only assistants. GPT-4 brought image input, stronger benchmark performance and a more extensive public safety evaluation into one frontier-model release.
html.zh: 大语言模型已经展示出较强的少样本学习与指令跟随能力，但领先系统仍主要以纯文本助手呈现。GPT-4 在一次前沿模型发布中同时带来图像输入、更强基准表现和更广泛的公开安全评测。

html.en: GPT-4 uses a transformer-based next-token prediction system whose implementation details were intentionally not disclosed in the technical report. Its product behavior combines large-scale pretraining with post-training alignment, while the release evidence focuses on measured capabilities, limitations and risk mitigations rather than a reproducible architecture recipe.
html.zh: GPT-4 使用基于 Transformer 的下一 token 预测系统，但技术报告有意不披露具体实现细节。其产品行为结合大规模预训练与后训练对齐，公开证据重点放在已测能力、局限和风险缓解，而不是可复现的架构配方。

html.en: Experts generally treat GPT-4 as a major 2023 capability threshold for multimodal general-purpose assistants and as a case study in evaluating opaque frontier systems. Its legacy includes both wider deployment of high-capability models and sharper debate about reproducibility, benchmark saturation, safety testing and model access.
html.zh: 专家通常把 GPT-4 视为 2023 年多模态通用助手的重要能力门槛，也把它视为评测不透明前沿系统的典型案例。它既推动高能力模型广泛部署，也加剧了围绕可复现性、基准饱和、安全测试和模型访问的讨论。

reviewNotes.en: Completed event-specific research on 2026-08-03 and expanded company-context research after copyright restrictions were relaxed. The exact BenchCouncil title, order, institution, country and blank contributor/publication fields remain preserved. Sam Altman is verified as OpenAI's founding co-chair and GPT-4-era CEO, and Greg Brockman as an OpenAI cofounder and public GPT-4 demonstrator; both are recorded only as related company figures, not GPT-4 authors or BenchCouncil official contributors. Their clear TED portraits are documented but not selected because the official contributor field is blank. The OpenAI logo candidate is sourced through a Commons mirror that identifies OpenAI as source and author, marks the text logo public domain for copyright purposes and warns that trademark restrictions remain. The package retains one original explainer and selectedPortrait remains null.
reviewNotes.zh: 于 2026-08-03 完成事件专项研究，并在放宽版权限制后扩展公司背景检索。BenchCouncil 的准确标题、顺序、机构、国家以及空人物/空论文字段均保持不变。现已核验山姆·奥特曼是 OpenAI 创立时的联合主席和 GPT-4 发布时期 CEO，格雷格·布罗克曼是 OpenAI 联合创始人并曾公开演示 GPT-4；两人只作为公司相关人物记录，不称为 GPT-4 作者或 BenchCouncil 官方贡献者。两张清晰 TED 肖像均已记录，但因官方人物字段为空而不选用。OpenAI 标识候选来自 Commons 镜像；文件页将 OpenAI 标为来源和作者，按文字标识说明其版权层面属于公有领域，同时警告仍受商标限制。本事件仍只使用一张原创解释图，selectedPortrait 保持 null。
